tui.app.sidebar.why_retry_budget.note: One clause in the sidebar's why-list; the list is joined in code, so no punctuation.

tui.app.sidebar.why_retired.note: One clause in the sidebar's why-list; 'retired' is the source lifecycle word, kept.

tui.app.sidebar.why_left_screen.note: One clause in the sidebar's why-list.

tui.app.skills.teams_heading.note: Heading of the teams block in the skills help; lower-case house style.

tui.app.skills.agents_heading.note: Heading of the agents block in the skills help.

tui.app.skills.led_by.note: Team row: manager then roster size. The plural moves the word into the message; the manager name is data and the count is shown raw.

tui.app.skills.send_agent.note: A command line the user types: the verb may translate, the syntax must not.

tui.app.skills.detach_agent.note: A command line the user types; same rule as send_agent.

tui.app.goals.settled_heading.note: Heading of the settled-goals block in the skills help.

tui.app.config.applied.note: Config-change receipt listing keys that took effect now; keys are identifiers and stay untranslated.

tui.app.config.effect_new.note: Verb agreement lives in the message so a translator can inflect it; /new is a command name and stays.

tui.app.config.needs_relaunch.note: Same agreement rule as effect_new; 'relaunch' is the thing that must happen.

tui.app.config.toggle_on.note: A two-valued switch turned on; the em dash separates the label from the lag note.

tui.app.config.toggle_off.note: The switch's off state; warns that calls are refused meanwhile.

tui.app.config.label_web_search.note: Switch name used in both toggle messages; lower-case house style.

tui.app.config.label_web_fetch.note: Switch name used in both toggle messages.

tui.app.parked.wakes.note: Count of parked wakes; the plural moves the noun into the message and the digit stays raw.

tui.app.parked.monitors.note: Count of parked monitors; same shape as the wake count.

tui.app.parked.dormant.note: Trailer after the parked counts; the leading em dash is layout and {parked} is the joined count phrases.

tui.app.stop_all.already_leaving.note: Sessions already shutting down; the phrase covers one and many, so only the digit varies.

tui.app.stop_all.will_be_stopped.note: The pronoun changes with the count, so the whole clause is pluralised in the message rather than a pronoun passed in from code.

tui.app.stop_all.repeat_hint.note: The command name and the seconds figure are technical; only the sentence translates.

tui.app.aida.next_checkin.note: Aida cadence row; {when} is already-humanised relative time.

tui.app.aida.extras_used.note: Aida extra check-ins; the two NBSPs keep the count from wrapping away from 'of' and are part of the string.

tui.app.signin.opening.note: Told before the browser opens; the ellipsis is part of the copy.

tui.app.signin.finished_hint.note: Two clauses joined by a middot; ctrl+c is a key name and stays.

tui.app.signin.full_link.note: The unshortened URL, for copying; the colon is the label separator.

tui.app.help.paste_note.note: Help-table note describing what the key does; the key name itself is a separate muted span.

tui.app.help.copy_note_more.note: Continuation of the copy note on its own line, aligned under the first.

tui.app.help.skill_note.note: Help-table note for the skill sigil; the sigil is a separate span.

tui.app.help.model_saved_note.note: Help-table note for /model saved; config.yml is a filename and stays.

tui.app.help.cmd_paste_note.note: Help-table note for cmd+v; names one terminal that does not forward it.

tui.app.help.title_note.note: Help-table note for the window title; the shell command and key path stay English.

tui.app.help.title_note_more.note: Continuation: the env var, the glyphs and the state words are all pinned by other docs.

tui.app.help.notify_note.note: Help-table note for notifications; the shell command and key path stay English.

tui.app.help.notify_note_more.note: Continuation: env var stays, the two delivery behaviours are the translatable part.

tui.app.notifications.more.note: Overflow prefix for the notifications listing; two leading spaces are an indent and the digit is raw.

tui.app.notifications.sidebar_hint.note: Overflow line plus the key that opens the full list; ctrl+b stays.

tui.app.notifications.mark_all_read.note: Shown when the listing is capped, so 'all' means more than what is visible; the command name stays.

tui.app.notifications.mark_these_read.note: The uncapped variant, where every listed item is on screen.

tui.app.providers.none.note: Placeholder in a status row when no leg is enabled; the brackets are part of the placeholder.

tui.app.providers.stale_all.note: Provider-status summary when every listed provider is stale; 'stale list:' is the label the status line already used.

tui.app.providers.stale_named.note: Same summary when only some providers are stale; names are identifiers.

tui.app.providers.stale_all_error.note: Model-picker status line; the error text after the dash is already localised from the wire.

tui.app.providers.no_live_list.note: Providers with nothing stored to list; names are identifiers.
